selection_basis: Geometric horizontal neighbors of the previously observed center; no glyph or new texture-value selection. All candidates fixed before reading the new texture values.
radius_rationale: Preserve the unresolved half-axis versus radius interpretation of the paper's seven-voxel axis; do not fit a radius to texture values.
sampling_loop: i=0 through int(radius/interval)-1; both signs; center duplicated
numeric_conventions: Cast position and normal to float32; normalize normal with a float64 norm and cast to float32; form scaled normal in float64 then cast to float32; add/subtract in float32. Interpolate in float64; nearest-even integer rounding. Candidate emulation, not verified bit-exact OpenCV execution.
missing_data_policy: Fail on invalid mask, nonfinite data or unavailable neighborhood; do not substitute zero or exclude points after observing residuals.
comparison_policy: Report all eight candidates, signed residuals, exact-match counts and absolute errors by development/held-out group; choose no winner automatically.
limits: These adjacent same-row coordinates are locally correlated numerical controls, not independently labeled ink or letters, a representative scan sample, or a transcription accuracy benchmark. No parameter tuning or contrast fitting in this pass.
